meta.title: Q-SIEVE
meta.simulation: Exact NumPy statevector, 256 complex amplitudes; no quantum hardware run
meta.scoreDescription: Sigmoid-scaled SVC decision score using a separate synthetic calibration split. Not a validated probability of financial crime.
meta.fixtureSelection: 12 varied illustrative windows selected by score from a separate 120-window synthetic demo pool. Demo selection does not affect test metrics.
caveats: Synthetic patterns and 30% suspicious prevalence are invented; results do not estimate real bank performance.
The kernel is computed on a classical simulator. No speedup, sample-efficiency gain or quantum advantage is established.
Near-zero net flow and short next-debit timing can occur in legitimate businesses.
€10,000 is a toy scenario parameter and not a statement about reporting law.
Evidence cards describe observable features; they are not causal model attribution.

features.label: Activity vs baseline
features.description: Transaction count divided by the account’s synthetic expected count for this 72-hour window.

features.label: Average transfer
features.description: Gross absolute transaction volume divided by transaction count.

features.label: Inbound count share
features.description: Credit count divided by all transactions; preserves flow direction.

features.label: Inbound value share
features.description: Total credits divided by gross absolute volume.

features.label: Net / gross flow
features.description: Signed (credits − debits) / (credits + debits). Near zero indicates pass-through; it does not establish wrongdoing.

features.label: Median next-debit delay
features.description: Median hours from each credit to the next later debit in the window. Timing proxy only; funds are not matched.

features.label: Distinct counterparties
features.description: Unique synthetic sending and receiving counterparties in this account window.

features.label: Near demo threshold
features.description: Share of transactions at €9,000–€9,999.99. €10,000 is a toy scenario parameter, not a reporting-law claim.

policy.thresholdBasis: Default demonstration route cutoffs fixed before evaluation: clear < 0.20, escalate ≥ 0.75, otherwise human review. They are not certified safe.
policy.closureRule: Only eligible clean-score cases may be auto-cleared. An escalated/suspicious disposition blocks automatic closure regardless of score.

models.name: ZZ fidelity + SVC
models.prAucDefinition: Average precision (step-weighted PR area), positive = synthetic suspicious.

models.name: RBF SVC
models.prAucDefinition: Average precision (step-weighted PR area), positive = synthetic suspicious.

models.name: Histogram gradient boosting
models.prAucDefinition: Average precision (step-weighted PR area), positive = synthetic suspicious.

evaluation.protocol: Independent account windows; fixed train/calibration/test seeds. Same features, same splits. Hyperparameters fixed; no test-set tuning. Timings are this local run only.

metricDefinitions.prAuc: Average precision on held-out synthetic suspicious cases.
metricDefinitions.recallAt90Policy: Test suspicious cases retained / all test suspicious cases, using threshold chosen to retain ≥90% of calibration positives.
metricDefinitions.falsePositiveEliminationAt90Policy: Test legitimate cases below that threshold / all test legitimate cases. Measures low-score alert elimination only, separate from the three-way demo route.
metricDefinitions.autoClearCoverage: Test cases below 0.20 / all test cases.
metricDefinitions.autoClearError: Synthetic suspicious cases below 0.20 / all test cases below 0.20.
metricDefinitions.retainedRecall: 1 − (synthetic suspicious cases below 0.20 / all test suspicious cases).

labelAblation.reason: This prototype has 72 labelled training positives; the full source-proposed benchmark requires more validated data and repeated splits.

hardware.reason: No hardware credentials or jobs used; no simulator-to-hardware claims.

xgboost.substitute: Histogram gradient boosting is labelled explicitly and is not XGBoost.

caveats: Single-seed synthetic sanity check, not an AML benchmark or production safety claim.
30% synthetic suspicious prevalence is deliberately enriched and unlike a live bank queue.
A 90% target on calibration does not guarantee 90% recall on unseen data.
Auto-clear defaults are demonstrative; audit and routing do not eliminate classification errors.
Baselines use fixed reasonable parameters, not exhaustive tuning; full-strength baseline selection remains future work.

model.fixedFeatureTransforms: log1p for velocity/amount/delay/counterparties; fixed domain bounds; net/gross shifted from [-1,1]; clip all to [0,1], multiply by π.
model.reproducibility: python model.py --output model-data.json regenerates windows, kernels, scores and metrics; machine-dependent timings differ.
